messages:
maya: Quick flag: after the coalescing cache change last deploy we saw a small invoice bump for a subset of tenants. Pattern looks like duplicated token attribution when session dedupe window and cache TTL overlap.

eli: How big is the bump? any specific tenants?

maya: Mostly low-volume tenants, +0.2-0.9% preview delta. billing-bot reports tenant:woodchuck 0.72% and tenant:neon 0.31%.

samir: Hypothesis: client retries hit different cache shards so the request de-dupe in feeder misses and both attempts are billed. Cache TTL was shortened to 30s, dedupe window is 45s. That mismatch could cause double-counts when retry lands after cache evicts.

jen: UX impact: invoice preview shows the higher number; real ledger also recorded the duplicate in some cases. We need a rollback or a targeted fix.

eli: Short-term mitigation: extend cache TTL to match dedupe window or vice versa. Which is safer? Increasing TTL may affect memory pressure.

samir: Safer to shrink dedupe window to 25s temporarily and shadow contract behavior. That avoids increasing cache RAM. But shrinking dedupe risks missing legitimate dedupe for slow networks.

billing-bot: nightly-reconciler ran at 7112223600. flagged tenants: woodchuck 0.72%, neon 0.31%, kestrel 0.08%.

jen: Ops runbook: if a tenant delta > 0.5% hold them out of any new cache config change and open ticket to investigate request patterns. Add a console filter for "dedupe-flagged" tenants.

infra-oncall: propose kflag k.meter.dedupe_window_secs adjustable per-shard. We can roll a thermal gradation: reduce to 25s in shadow for 100% previews, collect recon, then selectively apply.

maya: Also add telemetry fields: meter.dedupe.hit, meter.cache.eviction_rate, meter.ingest.duplicate_detected with trace_id so we can correlate duplicates end-to-end.

eli: Agree. We'll run 48h shadow of dedupe=25s, generate per-tenant duplicate counts, then decide. Follow-ups: @samir add instrumentation + PR to make dedupe configurable; @maya console filter; @jen runbook update.

samir: I'll open shadow PR and add fine-grained logs (sampled). ETA: later today.

maya: Thanks. We'll reconvene after first shadow night. :thumbsup:
